FDE2E SolidCraft {version} is this fork's parametric 3D CAD build, maintained by FDE2E.
[Source](https://github.com/jixoai/solidcraft) · [Issues](https://github.com/jixoai/solidcraft/issues) ·
[Documentation](https://github.com/jixoai/solidcraft/tree/feat/webmcp-worker/docs).

Changes are listed below. This is not an upstream release; upstream websites, stores and signing
certificates do not apply. Source, licence and compatibility boundaries:
[FORK.md](https://github.com/jixoai/solidcraft/blob/feat/webmcp-worker/FORK.md).

**Which file?** Use only the assets attached to this fork release.
- **Windows:** the `.msi`, `-portable.zip` or `SolidCraft-{version}-windows-x64.exe`.
- **macOS:** open the `.dmg` and drag `SolidCraft.app` to Applications. The CLI is in
  `solidcraft-cli-{version}-macos-universal.zip`.
- **Linux:** the `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.flatpak`, `.snap` or `.tar.gz` for your architecture.
  An upstream Snap Store or Flathub entry is not this fork's distribution.
- **FreeBSD:** `solidcraft-{version}-freebsd-x86_64.tar.gz`.
- **Web:** `solidcraft-web-{version}.zip` is a static site to host yourself. No public deployment
  address is implied by this release.
- **Checksums:** `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt --ignore-missing`.

Compatibility filenames, app IDs, storage paths and design formats remain stable despite the
public name change. See the release's actual signing evidence before treating an installer as
signed or notarised; no upstream signing status is inherited.

Licences and attributions are built in (Help > About > Licences, `solidcraft-cli licences`).
Packages retain `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt`, the original copyrights and project licence texts.
